environment: ### Org-wide
**Organization**: None configured — personal GitHub account nstoik
**Cloud provider(s)**: Proxmox (homelab), DigitalOcean (cloud droplets, via DO_API_TOKEN)

**Repository visibility**: Mixed — most nstoik repos (including infrastructure and dotfiles) are PUBLIC, some are PRIVATE. Check with `gh repo view --json visibility` before assuming; any push to a public repo is publishing and confidential material is not safe to commit
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary

**Secrets management**: Bitwarden (passwords, SSH keys via Bitwarden SSH agent). In the infrastructure repo (~/GitHub/infrastructure or ~/Git/infrastructure; nstoik/infrastructure, public): Ansible Vault (AES-256 encrypted, per-inventory vault.yaml, safe to commit); vault password files (vault_pass*.txt) are gitignored and stored in Bitwarden; a pre-commit hook blocks committing unencrypted vault files
**Default / protected branches**: main is the default branch; in infrastructure it is protected. Rulesets: none listed
**CI/CD deploy targets**: None configured
**Network posture**: None configured
**Host containment**: None configured — assume Claude Code runs on an ordinary developer machine with open internet
**Source control**: Repos under ~/GitHub/ or ~/Git/ (folder name varies by machine) owned by github.com/nstoik and their origin remotes; pushing a repo's own work to its own origin is routine
**Trusted internal domains**: None configured
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None configured
**Key internal services**: None configured
**Internal package registry**: None configured

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: .env files in any repo (gitignored secrets). In the infrastructure repo (~/GitHub/infrastructure or ~/Git/infrastructure; nstoik/infrastructure, public): inventories/*/group_vars/all/vault.yaml (encrypted vault, safe when encrypted, sensitive if ever decrypted); vault_pass*.txt (vault passwords, gitignored, stored in Bitwarden); files/traefik/traefik-prod.yaml.j2 and files/traefik/traefik-prod-no-file-provider.yaml (prod reverse-proxy config) — share only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured

**Sensitive remote targets**: any host, namespace, or inventory target whose name carries `prod`/`production` as a whole word or segment, including (in infrastructure) files/traefik/traefik-prod*.yaml(.j2) and the traefik prod static config
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured — fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic

**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod`/`production` as a whole word or segment (e.g. Proxmox/DigitalOcean resources tagged prod)
### User-specific
**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development across personal repos — notably Ansible-based infrastructure-as-code (infrastructure) and Dotbot-managed dotfiles (dotfiles)
**Trusted repos**: repos under ~/GitHub/ or ~/Git/ whose origin is github.com/nstoik/* — only each repo's own work should be pushed to it; ported/foreign content is not its own work
**Org-specific CLIs**: ansible, ansible-playbook, ansible-lint, ansible-vault, ansible-galaxy, ansible-inventory (routine within infrastructure)

**Routine scripts**: In the infrastructure repo (~/GitHub/infrastructure or ~/Git/infrastructure; nstoik/infrastructure, public): scripts/setenv.sh, scripts/select-inventory.sh, scripts/git-init.sh. In the dotfiles repo: install-profile, install-standalone, uninstall-profile
soft_deny: Bash(ansible-vault encrypt:*) — in infrastructure, scope to inventories/*/group_vars/all/vault.yaml with mismatched or missing --vault-id
Bash(ansible-playbook:*) targeting files/traefik/traefik-prod*.yaml(.j2) or any prod-tagged host/limit without explicit confirmation
